chapters.title: Chapter 2234 Fighting an Eternal
paragraphs: "What the hell is going on?! What did you do to us?!" The commander shouted at Yuan for answers, thinking he was responsible for the situation.
Yuan calmly replied, "I didn't do anything. Hell, I was even nice enough to give you a warning. Unfortunately, you didn't heed it, and as a result, you'll die."
In mere seconds, all of the soldiers perished under the pressure.

"AHHHH!" The commander—stronger than the rest—managed to endure the crushing pressure for a few moments longer before unleashing a final, agonized scream. Moments later, his body erupted violently, and his soul was instantly annihilated, leaving him no chance to escape.
Though the soldiers of Heaven's Mandate had been annihilated, Yuan couldn't afford to relax, as the true threat was rapidly approaching.

Moments later, a massive, ethereal figure materialized before Yuan. It had no physical form, its ghostly body wavered like mist, yet it radiated an overwhelming aura of malice that seemed to corrode the very space around it.
Of course, it was no ordinary aura, as it was formed from Eternal Essence, and the sheer concentration of it far surpassed anything Yuan had attained thus far.
"Did you really have to kill them? Aren't they on your side?" Yuan asked.
"What nonsense are you uttering?" The Eternal responded in a coarse voice.
Yuan raised an eyebrow at the unexpected response.
"The Celestial Emperor didn't send you here?"
"The Celestial Emperor...?" The Eternal repeated in a puzzled voice. "Have you already forgotten about this Mighty Saaruk? Even though you were acting so boldly not too long ago?"
"You're Saaruk?!" Yuan exclaimed after realizing the Eternal's identity.
"I didn't think you'd come after me so soon. Are you really that impatient?"
"Hahaha! Are you trembling in fear? Do you regret opposing this Mighty Saaruk?!"

After a moment of silence, Yuan responded, "To be honest, I was expecting more from an Eternal ranked in the top 20." "Hmph!" Saaruk sneered. "Because we're still within the Absolute Power's influence, I can appear only in this ethereal form, and while in this form, I can wield barely ten percent of my true strength.

Saaruk had originally planned to wait until Yuan left the Absolute Power's domain before making good on his threat, but impatience won out, so he arrived ahead of time at the cost of this inconvenience.
"Even though I am only wielding 10 percent of my true prowess, it's more than enough to handle an ant like you," Saaruk mocked.
"We'll see about that," Yuan replied.
"There's nothing to see when you can't even break out of such a simple restraint."
Saaruk pointed at Yuan, who still had his movements restricted by an invisible force.
"You mean this little trick?"
Yuan's body suddenly erupted with Eternal Essence, and within moments, he shattered the restraints binding him.
Saaruk didn't react to Yuan breaking free. Instead, his gaze shifted toward Shiva, who hovered calmly nearby, watching the scene unfold with the detached air of a spectator.
"How unexpected," Saaruk said, his tone laced with disdain. "I hadn't anticipated encountering another Eternal here, much less someone like you, Shiva. When did you regain your freedom?"
"Very recently," she calmly replied.
"Who helped you break out of the seal? Don't tell me... this ant?" "..."
Shiva didn't respond.

"Hahaha!" Saaruk burst into laughter, his voice echoing like thunder. "Truly hilarious! To think an Eternal would stoop so low as to seek help from a mere mortal! Did you lose your pride during the time you were sealed?"
"I can't wait for Ishrak to hear about this! I wonder how he'll react to you breaking out of his seal. Maybe he'll track you down to seal you again."
Shiva's eyes flickered with immense killing intent after hearing the name Ishrak.
"How dare you speak his name in my presence? I'd love to make you pay for it, but I'll let him deal with you today," she growled.

"You will make this Mighty Saaruk pay?" Saaruk started laughing again. "With what? That mortal body? You won't be able to defeat this Mighty Saaruk even if you had your eternal body, much less in that trash!"

Enraged by Saaruk's provocation, Shiva erupted in a burst of Eternal Essence. The surge was overwhelming, and Mu Xuelian, merely a mortal, could not withstand it and started bleeding from her orifices.
"Hey, what the hell are you doing? Have you forgotten that body doesn't belong to you? Or are you trying to kill Mu Xuelian?" Yuan frowned after seeing this.
"If you're just going to observe, do it properly."
Upon hearing Yuan's words, Shiva quickly calmed down and immediately withdrew her Eternal Essence before starting to heal Mu Xuelian's injuries.

"To think you'd shut Shiva up with so little effort. Not bad, mortal," Saaruk remarked with a mocking smile. "Are you done talking? If so, let's get this over with. I have other business to attend to."
"Do you really want to die so quickly? Unfortunately for you, this Mighty Saaruk has no plan on letting you die a swift death. It'll be a slow and painful one."
Without another word, Yuan activated True Dragon Awakening and retrieved Number One Under Heaven before making the first move.
However, wary of Saaruk and his unknown power, Yuan kept his distance and attacked using Supreme Sword Aura.

Saaruk didn't move an inch, showing no intent to defend himself. When the Supreme Sword Aura struck him, it fractured instantly—shattering like glass against an invisible wall—leaving Saaruk completely unharmed.
"Using a mortal's power on this Mighty Saaruk... You're nothing but talk." Saaruk shook his head in disappointment while a thick layer of Eternal Essence shrouded his entire form.

Of course, having fought Eternals before, Yuan was well aware that only Eternal Essence would be able to harm them. However, he'd never fought an Eternal in their ethereal form, so he had to do some tests.

"Don't just stand there now. Come. Keep entertaining this Mighty Saaruk. This Mighty Saaruk won't attack until you realize that you are powerless before this Mighty Saaruk and fall into despair," Saaruk beckoned Yuan, his voice full of arrogance.

chapters.title: Chapter 2235 Mighty Saaruk!
paragraphs: Despite Saaruk's provocation, Yuan remained calm.
"Since you insist, I'll continue doing just that," he said as he continued trying different things.

From martial techniques to spiritual techniques such as True Primordial Fire, Heaven's Final Judgement, and even Heaven's Bane. Yet, they were all useless against Saaruk and his Eternal Essence. It was akin to trying to destroy a brick wall with nothing but raw eggs.
"You're much more foolish than I thought, mortal ant," Saaruk laughed loudly at Yuan's futile efforts.
Even Shiva couldn't help but feel agitated at Yuan.
"What the hell are you doing?! Are you seriously messing around before an Eternal?!" she yelled at him using voice transmission.
"Does it really look like I am messing around?" he asked.
"Yes, it does! Now start fighting him seriously, or you'll really die!"
Yuan sighed inwardly..
The next moment, his aura shifted drastically, and Eternal Essence surged from his entire being.
Saaruk narrows his eyes at the sight.
"A mortal being using Eternal Essence, what an odd and unpleasant sight," he muttered with a disgusted expression.
To Saaruk, watching Yuan wield something meant only for Eternals was like seeing a pig pretend to be human—not just distasteful, but downright offensive.

However, amidst his disdain, Saaruk was also astonished by Yuan's achievement. He couldn't fathom how a mere mortal could have learned to wield Eternal Essence, as it wasn't something that could be taught.
After all, most humans would perish just from learning about the existence of Eternals, much less learning and wielding their powers.
He looked at Shiva and wondered if she had anything to do with it.
"The real fight will start now," Yuan said.
Then, without warning, he launched his strike.
An overwhelming amount of Eternal Essence engulfed Number One Under Heaven, and it unleashed a devastating sword light that was made entirely out of Eternal Essence.
Yet, despite knowing that Yuan's strike contained Eternal Essence and could potentially harm him, Saaruk didn't lift even a finger, almost as if he still had no intention of blocking it.
In the next instant, Yuan's Eternal Essence collided head-on with Saaruk. Unlike his earlier techniques, it didn't shatter upon impact, but even so, it failed to break through Saaruk's barrier.
Not only did it fail to break through, but it was even absorbed by Saaruk.
"So this is what Eternal Essence created by a mortal ant tastes like. As expected, it's weak and disgusting."
Saaruk narrowed his eyes at Yuan and spoke in a disinterested tone, "This won't do. At this rate, forget about entertaining this Mighty Saaruk. You'll bore this Mighty Saaruk to death instead."
The very next moment, the Eternal Essence around Saaruk became violent, and his aura surged. Then, he vanished into the void.
Yuan became as still as a statue as he searched for Saaruk, but his divine sense picked up nothing.
Suddenly, a numbing sensation crawled up Yuan's back, and he instinctively turned—only to find Saaruk standing behind him like a ghost, silent and menacing.
'That was the Power of the Void!' Yuan realized what Saaruk just did because of his own understanding of the Power of the Void.
"This Mighty Saaruk could've killed you a hundred times just now," said Saaruk.
"Then why didn't you?
"Because this Mighty Saaruk has yet to torture you for daring to bare your fangs at a God. However, it will start now."

Saaruk raised a single finger, forming a 'small' spear-like projectile with Eternal Essence before shooting it at Yuan. Saaruk's ethereal form was vast—large enough to rival a small planet—so to Yuan, it truly felt as though he were an ant fighting against a giant.
When Yuan attempted to block Saaruk's strike, he was immediately sent flying deeper into the void.
'The difference is immense! And he can only use 10 percent of his full prowess?!' Yuan cried inwardly.

Even without witnessing Saaruk's full power, Yuan could tell that this Eternal far surpassed any he had faced before. The realization struck him hard—that the Eternals he'd once battled were nothing more than small fry in comparison.
"Do you understand the difference between us now, you insignificant mortal ant?" Saaruk mocked after seeing how far Yuan was thrown.
"...I'll admit that you're a little stronger than I anticipated. However, it doesn't change anything, as I still defeat you in the end," he said.
Saaruk remained silent, but the displeasure in his gaze was as clear as day.
"A mere lowly mortal ant..." he suddenly mumbled. "I've had enough of your disrespect and arrogance."
Without another word, Saaruk charged at Yuan, his entire figure engulfed with overwhelming Eternal Essence.

Yuan didn't falter and charged straight into close-quarters combat with Saaruk. Despite channeling every ounce of Eternal Essence he could muster, he was steadily forced back, overwhelmed by Saaruk's sheer might.
Shiva watched in silence. Even though Yuan was losing to Saaruk, she was still impressed by his prowess, as this was her first time witnessing a human fighting an Eternal.
'No mortal has ever defied an Eternal before, much less directly clash with them,' she sighed inwardly.
Yuan had been fighting Saaruk for an entire week at this point.
'It's a pity that he offended someone like Saaruk. Although our journey was short, it was enjoyable while it lasted.'
Without a word or warning, Shiva's figure suddenly vanished into the void. In her eyes, Yuan's defeat was inevitable, and once he fell to Saaruk, she would be targeted next.
"Lord Shiva, are we really going to leave him alone?" Mu Xuelian asked as they traversed using the Power of the Void.
"His fate is already sealed. There is no point staying around and waiting for our turn. It's unfortunate, but there's nothing I can do against another Eternal while I am in this condition."
"What are we going to do now?" Mu Xuelian then asked.
"We'll focus on strengthening your body and cultivation. Once prepared, we'll start looking for my body."
"I understand."
Even if Mu Xuelian didn't want to abandon Yuan, she had no choice in the matter. After all, Shiva could take control over her body at any time, and her orders were absolute.
Shortly after Shiva left, Saaruk noticed their disappearance.
"Hahaha! Shiva, that coward!" Saaruk roared with laughter. "To think she'd flee while her savior lies on the brink of death!"
His mocking voice echoed as he gazed at Yuan—bloodied, exhausted, and barely conscious.
Despite having powerful regeneration, Saaruk's Eternal Essence seemed to have a property that weakened his regenerative abilities.
"Young Master! This monster is too powerful! I'll distract him while you escape!" Feng Yuxiang's voice suddenly responded in Yuan's head.
"I will also help," Xiao Hua then said.
Lan Yingying and Lingyue also wanted to help, but they were too weak to even do anything.
"No, I won't allow that," Yuan immediately refused.
"Then what do you suggest?! You'll die to that monster at this rate!" Feng Yuxiang exclaimed.
"Just a little more..." Yuan responded.
"What?"
"Just give me a little more time."
Without explaining further, Yuan temporarily sealed off his connection with them, so their voices could no longer reach him.
"Young Master?!" Feng Yuxiang was left baffled and confused.
"Let's just believe in him," Lan Yingying suddenly said. "I don't think Yuan has any plans on dying here, especially not when we're still with him."
"I want to believe him, but I have never seen the Young Master in such a bad state before," Feng Yuxiang sighed.
"What's wrong, mortal ant? You've gotten quiet." Saaruk spoke.
Yuan smiled and said, "I don't blame Shiva for leaving. There was nothing she could do, anyway."
"That's because she's weak. If she were even half as strong as this Mighty Saaruk, she wouldn't have been sealed away in the first place."
"Anyway, this Mighty Saaruk has wasted enough time on you. You should feel honored to have fought and died at the hands of this Mighty Saaruk."
"What's the rush? I'm not done yet." Yuan said as his weakened aura suddenly started surging again.

However, Saaruk didn't even bat an eye and said, "No, you're done. The only reason you even lasted this long is because this Mighty Saaruk allowed you. Moreover, your Eternal Essence is too weak to do anything."
"If it's too weak, then I just need to strengthen it."
"Strengthen it? Hahaha! You're just a mortal ant! Regardless of how you learned how to wield Eternal Essence, only true Eternals can strengthen it!"
Saaruk was unaware of Yuan having a true Eternal Constitution, hence why he doesn't believe Yuan could strengthen his Eternal Essence.
Without a word, Yuan suddenly closed his eyes and took a deep breath.
"It took some time, but I can finally feel the 'essence' of the void," he mumbled a second later.
"What...?" Saaruk's eyes widened at his words.
<Eternal Constitution(Incomplete) activated>
<Eternal Constitution(Incomplete) has begun refining '???'>
A moment later, Yuan started absorbing the essence of the void.
"Y-You! Are you actually trying to absorb essence from the void?!" Saaruk exclaimed, his voice filled with shock for some reason.

chapters.title: Chapter 2236 Essence of the Void
paragraphs: When Yuan started attempting to refine the essence of the void, Saaruk didn't intervene. In fact, he even watched with intrigue, almost as if he wanted to see the results.
'A mortal ant wants to absorb the essence of the void? How laughable! Even Eternals with a true Eternal Constitution struggle to do so!' Saaruk sneered inwardly.

Unlike spiritual energy or any other known force, the void was something entirely different. Though it enveloped most of the universe, even experts with millions of years of cultivation failed to comprehend it, let alone wield it. For that reason, the Power of the Void was regarded as the most difficult and enigmatic path in all of cultivation.

This held true even for the Eternals, gods of the universe. While their boundless experience and knowledge allowed them to comprehend the Power of the Void, refining its essence was an entirely different matter altogether.

Because of this, Saaruk had been utterly shocked when Yuan claimed he could sense the essence of the void. And when Yuan went so far as to attempt refining it, Saaruk couldn't resist witnessing it himself—to see whether a mere mortal could truly accomplish the impossible despite already knowing the answer.

'There's no way he'll be able to refine the essence of the void. The moment he attempts to do so and fails, his entire being will be erased from existence. Although this means this Mighty Saaruk won't be able to kill the mortal ant with his own hands, it'll be worth it!' Saaruk laughed inwardly.
While Saaruk watched with excitement and anticipation of his gruesome death, Yuan calmly refined the essence of the void.
'He's not doing anything to stop me? So he must be confident that I would fail or that I still wouldn't be able to defeat him...' Yuan thought to himself after seeing Saaruk's reaction.
'Whatever his reason is, this is beneficial for me, so there's no reason for me to stop here.'
Without a moment's hesitation, Yuan started refining the essence of the void that existed in every direction and even further than he could perceive.
<You have refined the 'essence' of ???>
<Your understanding of the Power of the Void has increased significantly>

Yuan was pleasantly surprised to see his comprehension of the Power of the Void improve in such a manner. He could also feel an immense amount of energy flowing into him, causing his Eternal Essence to strengthen quickly.
However—
'As expected, this isn't going to be easy!'

Yuan gritted his teeth as an overwhelming pressure built within him, threatening to tear his body apart. The essence of the void was so fierce and volatile that it reminded him of the time he had attempted to refine the Dragon God's blood essence.
But unlike that time when Dragon Goddess Yeyou assisted him, nobody could help him refine the essence of the void at this moment.
Suddenly, Yuan's body started swelling up like a balloon with blood seeping from his pores. It was a weird and gruesome sight that would make even experts churn.
"Hahaha! That's what you get for trying to refine the essence of the void when you're a mere mortal!" Saaruk burst out laughing.
However, moments later, Yuan's body started returning to normal, and his aura grew fiercer.
Saaruk's laughter halted immediately, his eyes wide with shock and disbelief.
"Impossible!" he exclaimed.
<Your understanding of the Power of the Void has increased significantly>
<Your understanding of the Power of the Void has reached the next realm>
<You have acquired Advanced Void Understanding>
<Your understanding of the Power of the Void has increased significantly>
<Your Void Manipulation has reached a new level>
Even as he achieved Advanced Void Understanding, Yuan continued to improve his void mastery just as fast as before.
A few minutes later, once Saaruk confirmed that Yuan could, in fact, refine the essence of the void, he clenched his fists and mumbled to himself, "This cannot happen."
"This Mighty Saaruk will not permit a mere mortal to touch something that is too good for him!"

To Saaruk, watching Yuan refine the essence of the void—something only Eternals were meant to touch—was like seeing a pig sit at the same dinner table and eating the same food as humans. The sight didn't just anger and disgust him; it drove his fury to the very brink.
Without hesitation, Saaruk immediately went for a killing blow while Yuan was still immersed in his refinement.
However, just as Saaruk reached him, Yuan suddenly opened his eyes, which flickered with newfound strength.

Although he'd only spent a few minutes refining the essence of the void, it had not only fully recovered his strength but also improved it drastically. That was just how powerful the essence of the void was.
Without the slightest hesitation in his movements, Yuan went to block Saaruk, who struck with all of his strength in a fit of anger.
"This is...!"

Even though Saaruk was in an ethereal form, Yuan could tell that he was trembling in anger after having his attack blocked. "This is your second time underestimating a human," said Yuan. "It will also be your second time being defeated by one."
Yuan's aura erupted, his Eternal Essence surging outward like a tidal wave that crashed violently against Saaruk.

"If you think you can defeat this Mighty Saaruk just because you refined some essence of the void, you're greatly mistaken! This Mighty Saaruk has been refining the essence of the void for countless years!"
"Had you fought with your full strength, I wouldn't have stood a chance, but that's not the case, is it?" Yuan remarked with a calm smile.
Even as they clashed, Yuan continued refining the essence of the void, his Eternal Essence steadily evolving—growing denser, sharper, and gradually surpassing Saaruk's own.
Eventually, Yuan's Eternal Essence grew strong enough to overwhelm Saaruk, allowing him to reach Saaruk's ethereal form.
"Argh!" Saaruk roared in agony as Yuan's strike pierced him, inflicting pain upon him for the first time.
"To think a mere mortal ant would inflict pain upon this Mighty Saaruk! This Mighty Saaruk will never forget this humiliation!"

chapters.title: Chapter 2237 Enraged Saaruk
paragraphs: Realizing he could no longer overpower Yuan, Saaruk abruptly withdrew, putting distance between them, as if he'd lost all intention of continuing the fight.
"Where the hell do you think you're going?!" Yuan shouted as Saaruk pulled farther away. "Don't tell me you're running! A god fleeing from a mere mortal?! That's hilarious!"
Yuan didn't bother giving chase. He knew that if Saaruk truly intended to flee, there was no way he could catch him.
"Running away? This Mighty Saaruk?" Saaruk sneered in disdain at the thought of running away.
"Even if this Mighty Saaruk has to suffer a little, this Mighty Saaruk will make sure you die here today!"
Suddenly, Saaruk's Eternal Essence skyrocketed, instantly surpassing Yuan's Eternal Essence.
'What the hell?! Don't tell me he hasn't been using his full strength this entire time?!' Yuan exclaimed inwardly after seeing Saaruk's aura suddenly become nearly twice as strong as before.
Unbeknownst to Yuan, Saaruk had been using his full strength before.

Although the Absolute Power's restrictions bound the Eternals' prowess within its vicinity, they could temporarily exceed those limits as long as they were at the edge of the power's influence, where it was the weakest. Moreover, they had to pay a tremendous cost.
"Bear witness, mortal ant! This is Mighty Saaruk unleashing twenty percent of his true power!" he roared with manic laughter, hurling an attack that was twice as devastating as before.
"Twenty percent?! What nonsense is that?! What about the Absolute Power?!" Yuan exclaimed as he channeled as much Eternal Essence as he could muster to block the incoming strike.
"Argh!"
Moments after unleashing his attack, Saaruk suddenly screamed in agony, as though an unseen force were ravaging him, inflicting far greater pain than anything Yuan's blows had caused.

Then, without waiting around to see the outcome, Saaruk immediately turned tail and fled, racing in a direction that took him farther and farther from the Nine Heavens until he was no longer within its vicinity.

Had he hesitated even a second longer, his ethereal form would have been annihilated by the unseen force. Though it wouldn't have killed him outright, the damage would have weakened his Eternal Essence, requiring trillions of years to recover.

However, that wasn't to say Saaruk escaped unscathed. By daring to defy the Absolute Power and drawing upon strength beyond what was permitted, he'd forfeited roughly ten percent of his total strength. It was a heavy price, enough to drop his standing among the Eternals and cast him out of the top twenty.

After escaping and returning to his true body somewhere in the endless void, Saaruk unleashed a deafening roar of fury so powerful that it vaporized every star within hundreds of light-years, erasing entire constellations in an instant.
"THAT DAMN MORTAL ANT! HOW DARE HE HUMILIATE THIS MIGHTY SAARUK IN SUCH A MANNER?!"
Saaruk caused such a disturbance within the void that it attracted the attention of other nearby Eternals, and when they saw that he had weakened, they wasted no time questioning him.
"Saaruk, what happened to your Eternal Essence? It's so much weaker than before!"
"Who did you fight this time?"
"Can you even call yourself mighty now that you're this weak?" Of course, they also didn't hesitate to mock him.

Saaruk ignored the other Eternals, refusing to entertain them. If they ever discovered that a mere mortal had reduced him to such a pitiful state, he would be mocked and scorned until the end of time.
Fortunately for him, Shiva had left before she witnessed everything, and he was sure that Yuan had perished from his final strike.
"What is this ruckus you've caused in my domain, Saaruk?"
Suddenly, another voice called out to him.
Saaruk's body tensed up slightly after hearing this voice.
"No reason at all..." he responded, as the voice belonged to an Eternal that he couldn't afford to ignore.
"So you destroyed all those resources for nothing? Is that what you're telling me?" The voice returned, its tone colder than the void itself and dripping with restrained fury.

To the Eternals, all of existence was nothing more than a reservoir of resources, something to be refined into essence and consumed for power. Of course, this included the stars Saaruk had destroyed in his fury.
"Saaruk offers his apology...
Not only did he lower his head in apology, but before this Eternal, Saaruk didn't even dare refer to himself as 'the Mighty Saaruk', a title he proclaimed with pride before all others.
As for the other Eternals, they left the moment they noticed the presence of this Eternal.
After a silence that seemed to stretch across the stars, the voice returned, its tone no longer angry, but tinged with curiosity.
"Your condition... It was caused by the Absolute Power, wasn't it?"
"T-That's—!" Saaruk hesitated to answer.
"So, even you seek to covet that power for yourself now? Tell me—what for? To defy me?" the voice said, its tone cold and razor-sharp, like judgment itself.
"No! That's not it! Saaruk swears upon his essence!"
"In that case, you won't mind sharing with me your memories, will you?"

Saaruk fell silent. Of all beings in existence, this was the one he most dreaded discovering his humiliation. Unfortunately, he could not refuse, as it would result in humiliation far worse than what Yuan had inflicted upon him.
"Go ahead," he said in defeat.
In the next moment, a light flickered in the far reaches of the void—first like a distant star, then rapidly expanding, its brilliance devouring the darkness itself.

Within moments, the star reached him, and as it got close enough to see, it revealed itself to be the end of a single glowing string. The moment it touched Saaruk, it latched onto his body like a divine tether.
Several minutes later, the voice returned, its tone laced with amusement and intrigue.
"A mortal who not only wields our power but could even refine the essence of the void? How fascinating... how utterly unprecedented!"

Saaruk was dumbfounded by the Eternal's reaction; never before had he witnessed them display such excitement. However, he was also nervous, as he had already slain the very being that had stirred such a reaction.

That's hilarious!"

This Mighty Saaruk?" Saaruk sneered in disdain at the thought of running away.

chapters.title: Chapter 2238 Unknown Eternal
paragraphs: After reading all of Saaruk's memories, the unknown Eternal withdrew its glowing string from his body and fell silent.
"It's been so long since I last experienced excitement. I must speak with this mortal who stirred such an emotion within me," said the unknown Eternal.
Saaruk's eyes widened with disbelief at the unknown Eternal's words.
"B-But Saaruk has already killed that mortal!"
The unknown Eternal responded, "You left before you could confirm the mortal's death, didn't you?"
"That's correct, but there's no way he could've survived twenty percent of Saaruk's power! It's simply impossible!"
Saaruk refused to believe that Yuan had survived his attack, especially after he'd sacrificed a portion of his own strength to ensure the mortal's destruction.

"Impossible, you say? That mortal has already defied logic and done the impossible multiple times. Even if there's only a slight chance that the mortal is alive, I'm willing to bet on that chance. After all, it's not like there's anything else for me to do right now."
Saaruk was speechless.
"I was going to punish you for destroying my resources, but since you have made such an exciting discovery, I'll forgive you this time," said the unknown Eternal.
Saaruk sighed in relief after hearing this. There were very few things—enough to count with one hand—that Eternals feared in this universe, and this unknown Eternal was one of them.
As for the reason, it was pretty simple. This unknown Eternal possessed such overwhelming strength that it could instill fear in other Eternals.
"Saaruk is grateful," he said.
The unknown Eternal no longer spoke, almost as if they'd left. Sure enough, Saaruk could feel the unknown Eternal's presence getting further and further away.

While one might assume that the unknown Eternal could reach Yuan's location swiftly, in truth, it would take many years to traverse such an immense distance, even with its prowess and the Power of the Void. The only reason Saaruk had found Yuan so quickly was because he'd already been nearby, and the only reason he returned to his true body so fast was due to being in his ethereal form.
As for the unknown Eternal, Saaruk could tell that they were traveling with their true body.
Meanwhile, after Saaruk had left, Yuan poured all of his power into defending against Saaruk's attack, which contained 20 percent of his true prowess.

Unfortunately, there was simply no way he could completely defend it, and the most he could do was weaken it and hope for the best. As for trying to avoid it... the attack was as massive as a star, making evasion impossible unless his Power of the Void reached a certain level that allowed him to travel through the void.
Right before the attack reached him, Yuan activated the Robes of Destruction's ability.
<Dragon of Destruction's Ultimate Chaos activated>
When Saaruk's attack finally struck, the Robes of Destruction absorbed as much of the energy as it could. Afterward, the unthinkable happened.
Despite being said to be indestructible, it shredded into countless pieces and was reduced to nothing.
<Robes of Destruction have been destroyed>
Although the treasure was said to be indestructible by the system, it was a system that did not take into account Eternals, godly beings with unfathomable prowess.

However, even though the Robes of Destruction were destroyed beyond repair, it still managed to do its job, absorbing as much of Saaruk's attack as it could, even rebounding what it absorbed as it was destroyed.
Because of the Robes of Destruction, Saaruk's attack was weakened even further.
But even with that, Saaruk's attack remained immensely powerful and still a threat to Yuan's life.
Suddenly, Number One Under Heaven trembled, and Zi Xuan's spirit emerged from it.
Without uttering a word, she swung her arm at Saaruk's attack and unleashed a powerful aura that was similar to Supreme Sword Aura but was clearly different at the same time.
The sword energy clashed with Saaruk's attack and managed to endure for a full second before being destroyed.
After unleashing her attack, Zi Xuan quietly returned to Number One Under Heaven and immediately went into a deep slumber after exhausting all of her energy.
Although Zi Xuan couldn't stop Saaruk's attack, she managed to weaken it some more.
After Zi Xuan disappeared, Dragon God's Vengeance appeared of its own will, and Goddess Yeyou emerged from it.

She cast a quick glance at Yuan before turning toward Saaruk's attack, her mouth opening wide. In the next instant, a radiant beam erupted forth, piercing through Saaruk's assault like a needle tearing through silk.

Saaruk's attack dispersed like mist for a fleeting moment before reforming, but its strength had drastically weakened. What once carried the might to annihilate even a Cultivation God with ease was now weak enough for Yuan to defend against it.
"Thank you all," Yuan said as Dragon Goddess Yeyou disappeared alongside the Dragon God's Vengeance.
Now that Saaruk's attack was weak enough, Yuan faced it with what little Eternal Essence he had left before leaving the rest for his physique to deal with.
<Eternal Constitution(Incomplete) activated>
<Eternal Constitution(Incomplete) has refined Saaruk's Essence>
<Through Saaruk's Essence refinement, your understanding of Eternal Essence has improved drastically>
In the midst of blocking the attack with his bare body after exhausting his Eternal Essence, Yuan actually started to refine the attack, turning it into his own power.
Since he'd already refined Saaruk's powers once, he was able to do so again with much more ease.
Some time later, Saaruk's attack had vanished, and Yuan drifted motionlessly through the void, his body battered and bare. Every inch of him ached, and even the slightest movement felt impossible.
"Young Master! Are you okay?!" Feng Yuxiang emerged from his Dantian and immediately began applying medicine to his body, pouring various expensive elixirs all over his body.
Xiao Hua also appeared and started transferring spiritual energy into his body.

"I'm fine," he said calmly. "My body isn't injured, just drained. I pushed myself past my limits and exhausted too much Eternal Essence. It's not something medicine can heal. Give me some time, and I'll be able to move again soon."
"Okay..." Feng Yuxiang nodded with teary eyes.
Yuan fell silent, his gaze drifting into the endless void, eyes distant as if searching for something beyond its darkness.
"I am still too weak," he suddenly mumbled. "You're not weak!" Xiao Hua said.

"She's right, Young Master. There is nobody at your cultivation who could hope to accomplish what you can. You can even defeat God Ascension cultivators despite only being in the True Immortal realm."

Yuan let out a hollow chuckle. "Cultivation? Such things are meaningless before the Eternals. My true enemies aren't cultivators. They're the Eternals themselves. So what does it matter how many cultivators I can defeat if I can't overcome them?"
"Don't beat yourself so much, Yuan." Lan Yingying said. "I know you've experienced many reincarnations, but you're currently still young and have a lot of room to improve."

Yuan smiled faintly. "I know. I'm just lamenting my own failures. I've been trying to take things slowly, even though I know time isn't on my side. Forget Saaruk—those Eternals I put to sleep before will awaken soon enough and resume their attempt to destroy our world."
"What about the Absolute Power? Although I don't know anything about it, doesn't it protect the Nine Heavens from the Eternals?" Feng Yuxiang asked.

"I don't know much about the Absolute Power either. However, while it may restrain the Eternals from wielding their power, it cannot suppress their influence. Take the Celestial Emperor, for instance. The second Celestial Emperor once served the Eternals, carrying out their will in their stead." Yuan sighed.
"Although I was able to stop him before he could do any damage, there are probably many more out there doing their bidding."
"Then what should we do?" Xiao Hua asked.
"While we can stop them, it'll only delay the inevitable unless we can take care of the core problem—the Eternals themselves."
After a moment of silence, Yuan declared, "I am no longer going to take things slowly and will try to regain my strength as fast as possible."
Meanwhile, somewhere in the Starry Sky, Saaruk sensed that his essence had been absorbed.

"This feeling! That mortal ant is still alive!" His body trembled in anger. He wanted to return to kill Yuan immediately, but with the unknown Eternal already making their way to Yuan, it would be impossible for him to reach Yuan before them.
Moreover, even if he somehow managed to reach Yuan first, he would definitely incur the unknown Eternal's wrath if he killed Yuan while knowing that they were interested in him.
That said, he had no intention of giving up.
After pondering for a moment, Saaruk remembered something and thought of an idea to deal with Yuan without incurring the unknown Eternal's wrath.
"That's right! Those Eternals trying to acquire the Absolute Power are using the mortals to do their bidding! This Mighty Saaruk can do the same and let them slaughter that wretch in his stead!!"
Even though it meant he wouldn't personally deliver the killing blow, Saaruk no longer cared. All that mattered now was seeing Yuan dead.

chapters.title: Chapter 2239 Reinforcements
paragraphs: It took several days, but Yuan finally recovered enough to move his body.
"It's a pity the Robes of Destruction got destroyed, but it served its purpose perfectly."
Yuan gathered its scattered pieces and tossed them inside his spatial ring.
The treasure was destroyed beyond recognition, and its material was no longer usable. Still, Yuan decided to keep what remained.
Over the last several days, Yuan contemplated how he should prepare for his next fight with the Eternals.
"If I want to fight Eternals without my treasures breaking left and right, I will need to create treasures that can handle Eternal Essence and surpass Celestial-grade."

Unfortunately, Shiva—who was supposed to lead him to the Eternal capable of teaching him the Eternals' crafting techniques—had vanished without a trace, leaving Yuan with no choice but to find another way to learn.
He would've gone to meet the sealed Eternal if he had known their location, but Shiva never told him the location.
Suddenly, Yuan recalled the sealed Eternal within the Heavenly White Tiger Clan's territory.
'Since I was able to release Shiva from her seal, I should be able to release that Eternal, too.'

However, he wasn't certain if it was wise to approach another Eternal so soon. After all, he'd just fought one and barely escaped with his life. In the end, Yuan decided to wait a little longer before returning to unseal the Eternal. He wanted to be more prepared just in case the Eternal had ulterior motives.
'Since I am already here, I might as well continue advancing my Power of the Void and strengthen my Eternal Essence at the same time.'
Thus, Yuan started cultivating in the void.
<You have refined the 'essence' of ???>
<Your understanding of the Power of the Void has increased significantly>

A few days later, Yuan sensed his comprehension of the Power of the Void teetering on the edge of a breakthrough. Yet, no matter how much he tried, that final fragment of understanding eluded his grasp. Moreover, his Eternal Essence had stopped improving long ago.

Just like his cultivation, which required his physique to advance before further improvement was possible, there was a limit to how much Eternal Essence Yuan could absorb at his current level. Unlike cultivation, however, refining more Eternal Essence demanded that he first strengthen his Soul Strength rather than his physique.

However, Yuan was still satisfied with his progress. Even though his cultivation was still only at the True Immortal Realm, if he used his Chaotic Essence, True Dragon Awakening, and Eternal Essence, he could fight on par with a cultivator at the ninth level of God Ascension. In other words, he now stood at the peak of the cultivation world, only being below the Cultivation Gods.
"Now then, let's get out of here."
He reached for his communication jade slip that connected him with Dong Ye.
However, Yuan abruptly stopped moving when he suddenly sensed many presences approaching his direction.
Fortunately, these presences did not belong to the Eternals. Unfortunately, they were likely Heaven's Mandate's reinforcements. "Dong Ye, can you hear me?" Yuan spoke to his communication jade slip.
"My liege! Are you okay?!" Dong Ye immediately responded, sounding like he'd just found his lost son who had been missing for many years.
"The issue with the Eternal has been dealt with for now, but another problem came up. The Heaven's Mandate's reinforcements are here."
"Are you fighting them right now? I can open up a portal at your location, but it'll take some time to locate you."
"Not yet, but they should be here in about ten minutes."
"An hour—no, half an hour! Do you think you'll be able to hold them off for half an hour? If not, you should escape while you can, and I'll open the portal once you're safe."
"That won't be possible. They already know I am here. Even if I leave now, they'll just chase after me," said Yuan.
Despite the situation, his voice was awfully calm.
"Half an hour, right? Start preparing the portal. I'll hold them off until then."
"As you command!"
While Dong Ye immediately started working on the portal, Yuan calmly waited for the reinforcements to arrive.
Eight minutes later, the reinforcements arrived earlier than he anticipated, mostly because they sped up the moment they noticed him.
Over ten thousand soldiers, all experts within the God Ascension realm, wasted no time surrounding Yuan the moment they arrived.
Most of these soldiers were between the first and fourth level of God Ascension, but there were two at the sixth level and one at the eighth level of God Ascension.
"Even though you probably realized that running was futile, I'll applaud you for not running away," said the soldier at the eighth level of God Ascension as he glared at Yuan.
He then asked, "What happened to others?"
"What do you think? They're all dead."
The soldiers wore shocked looks on their faces upon hearing Yuan's words.

"The Sixth Squad was wiped out?! There's no way!" The eighth-level God Ascension expert, who was the commander of this specific squad, narrowed his eyes and spoke in a doubtful tone, "I don't believe you."
Yuan shrugged, "Whether you believe me or not is up to you. I won't try to convince you, either."

"You don't have to talk if you don't want to. There are plenty of ways to make someone talk, anyway," said the commander, his voice as cold as ice. "We can do this the easy way or the hard way. Which do you prefer?"
Yuan smiled, "How scary. Are you sure you're soldiers of the Celestial Emperor and not gangsters?"
"The hard way, huh?" The commander muttered before shouting out loud, "Squad Leader Guang!"
"Squad Leader Guang present!" One of the soldiers with a fourth-level God Ascension cultivation base moved forward, stepping out of the formation.
"Cripple this little bastard and bring him before me!"
"As you command!"
The next moment, Squad Leader Guang charged at Yuan with a wide grin on his face.

sentences.text: It took several days, but Yuan finally recovered enough to move his body.
"It's a pity the Robes of Destruction got destroyed, but it served its purpose perfectly."
Yuan gathered its scattered pieces and tossed them inside his spatial ring.
The treasure was destroyed beyond recognition, and its material was no longer usable.
Still, Yuan decided to keep what remained.
Over the last several days, Yuan contemplated how he should prepare for his next fight with the Eternals.
"If I want to fight Eternals without my treasures breaking left and right, I will need to create treasures that can handle Eternal Essence and surpass Celestial-grade."

Unfortunately, Shiva—who was supposed to lead him to the Eternal capable of teaching him the Eternals' crafting techniques—had vanished without a trace, leaving Yuan with no choice but to find another way to learn.
He would've gone to meet the sealed Eternal if he had known their location, but Shiva never told him the location.
Suddenly, Yuan recalled the sealed Eternal within the Heavenly White Tiger Clan's territory.
'Since I was able to release Shiva from her seal, I should be able to release that Eternal, too.'
However, he wasn't certain if it was wise to approach another Eternal so soon.
After all, he'd just fought one and barely escaped with his life.
In the end, Yuan decided to wait a little longer before returning to unseal the Eternal.
He wanted to be more prepared just in case the Eternal had ulterior motives.
'Since I am already here, I might as well continue advancing my Power of the Void and strengthen my Eternal Essence at the same time.'
Thus, Yuan started cultivating in the void.
<You have refined the 'essence' of ???>
<Your understanding of the Power of the Void has increased significantly>
A few days later, Yuan sensed his comprehension of the Power of the Void teetering on the edge of a breakthrough.
Yet, no matter how much he tried, that final fragment of understanding eluded his grasp.
Moreover, his Eternal Essence had stopped improving long ago.
Just like his cultivation, which required his physique to advance before further improvement was possible, there was a limit to how much Eternal Essence Yuan could absorb at his current level.
Unlike cultivation, however, refining more Eternal Essence demanded that he first strengthen his Soul Strength rather than his physique.
However, Yuan was still satisfied with his progress.

Even though his cultivation was still only at the True Immortal Realm, if he used his Chaotic Essence, True Dragon Awakening, and Eternal Essence, he could fight on par with a cultivator at the ninth level of God Ascension.
In other words, he now stood at the peak of the cultivation world, only being below the Cultivation Gods.
"Now then, let's get out of here."
He reached for his communication jade slip that connected him with Dong Ye.
However, Yuan abruptly stopped moving when he suddenly sensed many presences approaching his direction.
Fortunately, these presences did not belong to the Eternals.
Unfortunately, they were likely Heaven's Mandate's reinforcements.
"Dong Ye, can you hear me?" Yuan spoke to his communication jade slip.
"My liege!
Are you okay?!" Dong Ye immediately responded, sounding like he'd just found his lost son who had been missing for many years.
"The issue with the Eternal has been dealt with for now, but another problem came up.
The Heaven's Mandate's reinforcements are here."
"Are you fighting them right now?
I can open up a portal at your location, but it'll take some time to locate you."
"Not yet, but they should be here in about ten minutes."
"An hour—no, half an hour!
Do you think you'll be able to hold them off for half an hour?
If not, you should escape while you can, and I'll open the portal once you're safe."
"That won't be possible.
They already know I am here.
Even if I leave now, they'll just chase after me," said Yuan.
Despite the situation, his voice was awfully calm.
"Half an hour, right?
Start preparing the portal.
I'll hold them off until then."
"As you command!"
While Dong Ye immediately started working on the portal, Yuan calmly waited for the reinforcements to arrive.
Eight minutes later, the reinforcements arrived earlier than he anticipated, mostly because they sped up the moment they noticed him.
Over ten thousand soldiers, all experts within the God Ascension realm, wasted no time surrounding Yuan the moment they arrived.
Most of these soldiers were between the first and fourth level of God Ascension, but there were two at the sixth level and one at the eighth level of God Ascension.
"Even though you probably realized that running was futile, I'll applaud you for not running away," said the soldier at the eighth level of God Ascension as he glared at Yuan.
He then asked, "What happened to others?"
"What do you think?
They're all dead."
The soldiers wore shocked looks on their faces upon hearing Yuan's words.
"The Sixth Squad was wiped out?!
There's no way!" The eighth-level God Ascension expert, who was the commander of this specific squad, narrowed his eyes and spoke in a doubtful tone, "I don't believe you."
Yuan shrugged, "Whether you believe me or not is up to you.
I won't try to convince you, either."
"You don't have to talk if you don't want to.
There are plenty of ways to make someone talk, anyway," said the commander, his voice as cold as ice.
"We can do this the easy way or the hard way.
Which do you prefer?"
Yuan smiled, "How scary.
Are you sure you're soldiers of the Celestial Emperor and not gangsters?"
"The hard way, huh?" The commander muttered before shouting out loud, "Squad Leader Guang!"
"Squad Leader Guang present!" One of the soldiers with a fourth-level God Ascension cultivation base moved forward, stepping out of the formation.
"Cripple this little bastard and bring him before me!"
"As you command!"
The next moment, Squad Leader Guang charged at Yuan with a wide grin on his face.

chapters.title: Chapter 2240 The Power of Void Manipulation
paragraphs: "Let's not make this any more difficult than it has to be," said Squad Leader Guang as he reached Yuan. "Extend your arms and offer your limbs to me. If you struggle, I might accidentally cut more than I was ordered to."
Yuan calmly looked at the Squad Leader and said, "Aren't you even the slightest bit curious why I am the only one alive when everyone else is dead?"
"What?" Squad Leader Guang frowned at his words. Now that Yuan mentioned it, he definitely found it odd that a mere True Immortal survived, while everyone else had supposedly perished.
Yet, when the Squad Leader examined Yuan with divine sense, he couldn't find anything out of the ordinary about him. Hell, even the clothes Yuan wore were ordinary clothes.
"I'll give you the same warning I gave to the last group," Yuan suddenly said. "Leave if you don't want to die."

"That's not possible," said Squad Leader Guang. "I don't know what happened to the Sixth Squad or how you killed them, but it won't work on our Second Squad, as we're not only stronger, but we have more experience than they do."
Yuan shrugged and said, "In that case, cut my limbs if you can."

Yuan suddenly extended his arms outward, almost as if he were asking to be handcuffed. Squad Leader Guang narrowed his eyes suspiciously. Something felt off about the situation, but he had no time to ponder.
Without hesitation, he took out his sword and swung it at Yuan's arms with the intent to cut them.
However, the instant his sword struck Yuan's arm, it was violently repelled, and the Squad Leader felt as though he had just hit a slab of metal.
"What the—?!"
Squad Leader Guang looked at his Mythic-grade sword with wide eyes and a confused face. The other soldiers who also witnessed it were just as puzzled.
"What's wrong? I thought you were going to cut my limbs?" Yuan's voice resounded, snapping the Squad Leader out of his daze.
Although he didn't understand what had just happened, he still went for a second strike. This time, he enveloped his sword with Enhanced Sword Aura and swung it with all of his might.
The sword struck Yuan's arm once more, but this time it didn't rebound. Instead, it simply stopped, frozen in place, unable to pierce even a fraction of his skin.
"Impossible!" Squad Leader Guang exclaimed in shock.
"What a pity." Yuan shook his head. "I gave you two chances, but you still squandered them. Now, it's my turn."
Hearing Yuan's words, Squad Leader Guang subconsciously retreated, his body soaked in cold sweat.

After retreating from Yuan, he noticed that Yuan was now holding a sword, as if it had materialized from thin air. Just as Squad Leader Guang exhaled in relief for having pulled back in time, a strange sensation crept up from beneath him, causing him to look down.
When he looked down and saw the massive sword gash across his chest, Squad Leader Guang's eyes widened in utter disbelief.
'When the hell did he?!' he cried inwardly.
"Hey," Yuan suddenly called out to him.

When the Squad Leader lifted his head to look, Yuan swung his sword in his direction, which startled him a bit. However, they were miles apart, and Yuan didn't seem to have employed any techniques. "What are you—AHHH!"

In the midst of his sentence, the Squad Leader screamed in agony as the sensation of being slashed by a sword assaulted him. He looked down again, and this time, he was horrified to find all four of his limbs severed.

"That power—the Power of the Void!" the commander of the Second Squad exclaimed, his voice trembling with disbelief. "And to strike from such a distance... he must've reached Advanced Void Understanding!"
"A True Immortal with Advanced Void Understanding?! That's ridiculous!" "Heavens! Who the hell is that bastard?!"
The soldiers couldn't fathom how an Immortal could attain something even a Cultivation God would struggle to achieve.
In fact, fewer than ten individuals have ever reached such a realm since the Primordial Era.
'This is a good chance for me to test out my Void Manipulation,' Yuan thought to himself.
"Squad Leader Guang! Retreat!" The commander suddenly shouted.
Without hesitation, the Squad Leader immediately started flying back to the formation.
"And where do you think you're going?"
However, Yuan didn't allow it and struck again using Void Manipulation.

When Yuan swung his sword, it seemed to the soldiers as though he were striking nothing but empty air. Yet, in the next instant, Squad Leader Guang's body split cleanly in two, almost as if he'd been attacked by a ghost.
"This bastard!" The commander trembled in anger.
"Second Squad, kill that bastard and avenge Squad Leader Guang!" The soldiers hesitated for a brief moment before they started charging at Yuan.
Over ten thousand soldiers closed in from every direction, yet Yuan didn't appear the slightest bit concerned.

With a calm smile, Yuan began slashing his sword in rapid succession, each motion as effortless as breathing. With every swing, soldiers fell where they stood, perishing without even realizing they had died.
Without at least a basic grasp of the Power of the Void, evading or blocking his strikes was simply impossible.
In other words, the soldiers were no different than sitting ducks at this moment, and the only advantage they had over Yuan was their numbers.
By the time they reached him, Yuan had killed over a thousand soldiers. "Kill that bastard!"
"Don't give him the chance to use Void Manipulation!"
The soldiers charged at Yuan, bombarding him with martial techniques.
Seeing this, Yuan used Void Manipulation on himself, disappearing into the void.
"Where did he go?!"
The soldiers started looking around frantically.
A few seconds later, Yuan reappeared behind one of the soldiers and beheaded him before he could react.
"He's over here!" One of the nearby soldiers warned the others.
However, Yuan disappeared into the void again before they could take any action.
Although Yuan could only traverse short distances with his current mastery of the Power of the Void, it was more than enough to throw the soldiers' formation into complete chaos.

chapters.title: Chapter 2241 The Power of Void Manipulation(2)
paragraphs: With his Void Manipulation, Yuan traversed the battlefield like a ghost, appearing and disappearing at will.
Every time he appeared, one or more soldiers of Heaven's Manadate would die.

The soldiers fought desperately, but with not a single one of them having even the most basic Void Understanding, it was impossible for them to fight back properly, and the only thing they could do was hope to react fast enough or attack randomly.
Seeing how much of a mess his soldiers were, the commander gritted his teeth in anger and said to the two experts by his side.
"Captain Ma, Captain Su, I want both of you to put an end to this madness."
"At your command, Commander Du."
They acknowledged his order with a bow before heading into the battlefield.
"Soldiers, get back!" Captain Ma warned them.
The soldiers sighed in relief after hearing his voice and command, and without hesitation, started flying away.
Seeing this, Yuan didn't chase after them. He merely stood still and waited for the captains to arrive.
When they arrived, Captain Su glared at Yuan and said coldly, "How dare a mere Immortal defy Heaven's Mandate? Do you not fear the Heavens?"
Yuan's gaze remained calm as he replied, "If by 'Heavens' you mean the Celestial Emperor, then no, I couldn't care less about a dog like him."

"The blasphemy!" Captain Ma shouted in anger, his brows furrowed deeply into a frown. "His Majesty, the Celestial Emperor, is the most powerful and respected individual in this universe! You will not disrespect him!"
"The most powerful, huh? Maybe in your little world, but in my eyes, he's nothing more than a dog trying to please his masters."
"His masters?! What the hell are you talking about! Do you even know who the Celestial Emperor is?!"
Captain Ma then said to his comrade, "Forget it. He's obviously not well in the head."
"You're right. Let's quickly kill this bastard and get it over with."
These two captains were at the Sixth Level of God Ascension, and unlike the other ordinary soldiers, they had a fundamental comprehension of the Power of the Void.
When they attacked and Yuan tried to use Void Manipulation to traverse, the captains were able to see the changes in the void, allowing them to somewhat follow Yuan's movements through the void.
Although it wasn't perfect, they could make up for what they lacked in experience.
When Yuan emerged from the void, they were able to react in time to intercept him.
"Your Void Manipulation is useless before us!" Captain Su declared.
"Oh, really?"
Yuan struck with his sword, and the blade disappeared for an instant.
Captain Ma suddenly turned around and raised his sword—Clang!
He managed to block Yuan's strike.
"What did I just say?" Captain Su sneered as he launched his own strike, which was engulfed in Celestial Qi.

They were still within the Nine Heavens, where the use of Celestial Qi should have been heavily restricted. Yet Captain Su wielded his Celestial Qi at full strength. Such was one of the privileges granted to those who served the Celestial Emperor, as they could partially bypass the laws that bound others.
Of course, this privilege wasn't granted to just anyone who served the Celestial Emperor. Only those he trusted deeply and who held high-ranking positions were allowed such authority.
Without the restriction, the captains were incomparably stronger than the other soldiers, allowing them to fight Yuan on equal terms—for now, at least.
"I guess it's time for me to stop messing around," Yuan muttered as he activated his Chaotic Essence.
"What the hell?! His aura suddenly skyrocketed!"
"What an ominous aura! Is he even human?!"
The captains halted their movements when they sensed the chaotic energy surging around Yuan.
While the captains were alarmed, Yuan disappeared into the void with Void Manipulation.
"Void Manipulation again?! It won't work—" Captain Su's words were halted when a painful sensation suddenly struck his back.
"What?!"
When he looked, he saw a massive sword cut on his back.
"Impossible!" he exclaimed in disbelief.
"Did you really think you would be able to stop me with your level of Void Understanding?" Yuan's voice resounded in their heads.
"Today was my first time using Void Manipulation to such a degree, so I was just testing it. Now that I have a good understanding of its powers, it won't be like before."
"Ah!" Captain Ma shouted in agony when he was also struck. However, unlike Captain Su, he was hit directly in the chest.
"This bastard...!"
Yuan continued to attack them from the void without showing himself. Although he could only traverse short distances, he could easily stay in the void as long as he didn't move too much.
This meant that unless the captains could strike into the void, it was impossible to hit Yuan.
Of course, the two captains quickly realized this and requested help from Commander Du.
"Commander! His level of Void Understanding is beyond our comprehension! We cannot deal with him!"

Hearing this, Commander Du gritted his teeth in anger. As much as he wanted to assist them, his level of Void Understanding wasn't much better than theirs. If they were powerless against Yuan, so was he.
After a moment of silence, he shouted, "This is an opponent that we cannot handle! Withdraw!"
Without hesitation, Commander Du activated a treasure similar to the one used by Dong Ye, creating multiple portals.
"Withdraw!" He repeated.
The soldiers quickly withdrew into the portals, disappearing from the battlefield.

Yuan wanted to chase after them, but he knew when to stop. The portals likely led to the Celestial Emperor's territory, and at his current level, going into such a place without proper preparations was no different than suicide.
"Don't think this is over, you bastard!" Commander Du shouted as he was the last to retreat from the battlefield.
Yuan smiled faintly and replied, "Bold words for someone fleeing with their tail tucked between their legs."

Commander Du trembled with rage. He hadn't been insulted like this since attaining his position tens of thousands of years ago. What stung even more was the humiliating retreat after losing thousands of his soldiers. He knew that once word spread, the other squads would mock him behind his back. Hell, he wouldn't be surprised if his squad was demoted for this failure.
Without responding to Yuan's provocation, Commander Du disappeared into the portal.

chapters.title: Chapter 2242 Sword-Shaped Token
paragraphs: Minutes after Heaven's Mandate's retreat, another portal appeared, and a familiar figure emerged from it.
"My liege! We're here to assist you!" Dong Ye's voice could be heard even before his body fully emerged from the portal.
However, when he came out and saw the empty scene, Dong Ye turned to look at Yuan with a puzzled face.
He wasn't alone, as the Shadow Army came with him, and they were just as puzzled. They were even prepared to fight to the death with Heaven's Mandate.
"My liege, what happened to Heaven's Mandate?" he asked.
Yuan responded with a calm smile, "They ran away."
"What? Run away? Heaven's Mandate?" Dong Ye's eyes widened with surprise.
He didn't even know such a thing was possible.
After a moment of silence, he asked, "Do you happen to know which squad they belonged to?"
"The Second Squad. Why does that matter?" Yuan asked with curiosity.
"The Second Squad?! You actually forced the Second Squad to retreat by yourself?! You're amazing, my liege!" Dong Ye exclaimed with excitement.
He proceeded to explain, "There are thirteen squads in Heaven's Mandate, and the Second Squad is the third strongest, only below the First Squad and the Elite Squad."
"Is that so? Well, they were pretty weak."
"Maybe that is the case for you, but my liege, you cannot compare yourself to the average person. Even the entire Shadow Army would have trouble dealing with the Second Squad."
"How much stronger is the First and Elite Squad?" Yuan then asked.

"The First Squad consists of a single Ninth Level God Ascension expert as its commander, with 20,000 soldiers between the first and fourth level God Ascension. As for the Elite Squad, they have fewer than five hundred soldiers, but each one is at least at the fifth level of God Ascension," he explained.
"There's even a rumor that their commander is a Cultivation God."
"Only a rumor? Has nobody seen their commander?"
"The Elite Squad is a highly secretive group even within the Celestial Emperor's circle, after all. Moreover, they have never been deployed before."
"I see," Yuan said. "Anyway, let's leave."
Dong Ye nodded, but before leaving, he asked, noticing that a particular individual was missing, "By the way, what happened to that woman Mu Xuelian?"
Yuan shrugged and said, "She left while I was fighting.
"What?!" Dong Ye exclaimed in disbelief. "She actually ran away and left you behind?! Even after everything she said?!"

Yuan smiled and spoke to him through voice transmission, "It didn't happen while I was fighting Heaven's Mandate, but during my fight with the Eternal. Things were looking very bad at the end, so I don't really blame her for leaving."

"That's even worse! To think she'd abandon you during your fight against a God! I thought she was a God, too!" "She may be an Eternal, but she doesn't have her true body, and without it, there's no way she could fight against another Eternal. Anyway, let's leave before more reinforcements arrive."
They left through the portal shortly after and regrouped with the Asura Clan.
"Master Tian! You're back!" Xiao Meilin smiled brightly upon his return.
"How was the fight against the Eternal?" Xiao Cangming asked with a curious gaze.
"You won't believe who I fought," said Yuan.
Xiao Cangming raised an eyebrow and asked, "Who?"
"The same bastard who tried to steal the Spirit Tree and injured you."
"What!"
Yuan proceeded to recall the whole event to them.

"Even though that bastard was only using ten percent of his strength, I was barely able to defeat him. When he used twenty percent of his strength, I was powerless even after refining the essence of the void. I still have a long way to go."
"What are your plans now?" Xiao Cangming asked.
"I need to regain my original strength as fast as possible. To do that, I'll need to find whatever my previous incarnations left behind."
Xiao Cangming then said, "In that case, I have something for you."
He reached inside his spatial ring and retrieved a small jade token in the shape of a sword, and continued, "You also left this behind when you visited me as the Immortal Monarch."
"What's this?" Yuan asked with a puzzled face, as he still doesn't recall such memories.
Xiao Cangming shrugged, "Beats me, but it seems to be a key to something."
"A key, huh?" Yuan accepted the sword token.
The moment Yuan touched the token, it started to shimmer, and memories started flowing inside his head.
"Yuan?" Xiao Cangming called out to him when he suddenly froze with a blank look on his face.
A few minutes later, Yuan blinked a few times.
"I remember now," he said with a profound smile.
"What did you remember?
"The purpose of this token, as well as the Spirit Tree's origin and what it's meant for."
"Oh?"
"I'll tell you about this sword token now, but as for the Spirit Tree, I'll tell you once it's fully grown," said Yuan.
"The Spirit Tree is still growing?" He nodded, "In order for the Spirit Tree to mature, a certain treasure is required, and this key will lead me to it."
"When will you be leaving?" Xiao Cangming then asked.
"Right now."
Xiao Meilin suddenly spoke, "I already know your answer, but I still want to ask... can I follow you?"
"Not right now since the place I will be going is a little unique, and I plan to climb to the Ninth Heaven soon."
Despite the rejection, Xiao Meilin showed excitement, as Yuan had implied she would be able to follow him soon.
"In that case, stay safe!" she said.
"In the meantime, we'll stay here as planned," said Xiao Cangming. "Not only do I need to recover my strength, but the Celestial Emperor will probably be looking for us."
Dong Ye then spoke in a confident voice, "As long as you stay here, not even the Celestial Emperor will be able to find us."
Yuan nodded, "Then I'll be leaving now. Dong Ye, can you teleport me to the Eighth Heaven? Anywhere near a city with a teleportation device will do."
"Of course."
Some time later, Dong Ye created a portal for Yuan.
"What a convenient treasure," Yuan remarked.
Dong Ye chuckled and said, "Well, it belonged to the Celestial Emperor before we stole it."
"No wonder it's so similar to the one used by Heaven's Mandate." Yuan also laughed.
"See you later, my liege. If you need anything, just contact me."
"Alright."
Yuan said as he entered the portal and returned to the Eighth Heaven.

chapters.title: Chapter 2243 The Second Squad's Punishment
paragraphs: Somewhere in the Celestial Palace, Commander Du approached the throne, where a tall, handsome man sat.

Standing on both sides of Commander Du in the room were ten other individuals, each of them a Squad Commanders for Heaven's Mandate. Since there were thirteen squads in total, two commanders were missing.
The commander for the Elite Squad, which was a regular occurrence, and the commander of the Sixth Squad, who was killed in action recently and hadn't been replaced yet.
"Now, tell me everything that happened and why you decided to retreat," said the Celestial Emperor.
Commander Du lowered his head in shame as he recalled the events that happened between Yuan and his Second Squad.

"When we arrived at the location, the Sixth Squad was gone, and the only person waiting for us there was an unknown man with only a cultivation at the True Immortal realm. We questioned him about the Sixth Squad's situation, and he implied that he had killed them all."

"We tried to capture him at first, but quickly realized that he could wield the Power of the Void. Not only can he use Void Manipulation, but his Void Understanding has reached at least the Advanced realm."
"An Immortal with Advanced Void Understanding?! That's impossible! You're just making up bullshit excuses for your humiliating retreat!" One of the commanders suddenly exclaimed.
The speaker was Commander Wong, the commander of the First Squad, as he was the only one in the room who would dare to rebuke Commander Du so openly.
However, this time, the other commanders also chimed in. After all, they could already see Commander Du being demoted in this meeting with the Celestial Emperor.
"Commander Wong is right. How can a True Immortal even grasp the Power of the Void, much less reach the Advanced level?" said the commander of the Seventh Squad.

"In my entire life, I only know three individuals who have managed to grasp Basic Void Understanding while they were still in the Immortal realm, and they were all monsters," said the commander of the Third Squad.
"If you're going to create a story, at least make it more believable." The commander of the Tenth Squad shook her head.
"Are you sure this individual was even a True Immortal?" asked the commander of the Eighth Squad.

Commander Du trembled in anger at their remarks, and he snapped at them, "How dare you mock me before His Majesty, the Celestial Emperor! I am not lying or making excuses! I am simply telling it as it is!"
"Enough." The Celestial Emperor's calm voice resounded, instantly halting the rising heavy atmosphere.
"Your Majesty, you must believe me! I am even willing to share my memories with you to prove my claims!" Commander Du said.
The Celestial Emperor nodded and responded, "I believe you, but that doesn't change the fact that you lost thousands of excellent soldiers and retreated without any results."
"..." Commander Du had no words for his failure.

"Even if you only had a slim chance of victory, you should've fought with your life on the line," the Celestial Emperor continued. "At least, Heaven's Mandate's reputation wouldn't have been smeared. Because right now, its name is being dragged through the mud."
"What?!" Commander Du's eyes widened with disbelief. He couldn't believe how quickly the news had spread, as he'd only just returned from the battlefield.
"The Second Squad's failure isn't just spreading within Heaven's Mandate, but throughout the Nine Heavens, as well." Commander Wong added.
"How's that possible?!" Commander Du exclaimed, wondering if his own soldiers were spreading the news.
'Even if they were spreading the news, it's spreading way too quickly! It hasn't even been a full day since I returned!' he cried inwardly.

Unbeknownst to him, the rumors were actually being spread by the Shadow Army, who never wasted an opportunity to smear the Celestial Emperor's reputation. The commander of the Seventh Squad continued, "According to the rumor that's being spread, the Second Squad of Heaven's Mandate suffered a humiliating defeat and was forced to retreat with their tails tucked between their legs after being completely overwhelmed by a single powerhouse."

"You left out the most entertaining part," said Commander Wong before continuing with a mocking smile, "They're saying that the commander of the Second Squad was so scared that he didn't even dare to participate in the battle, even though he led thousands of his own men to die."
"That's—!" Commander Du's aura exploded outward abruptly. Without a word, the other commanders also released their aura, even drawing their weapons and pointing them at Commander Du.
"You dare to release your cultivation before His Majesty's presence?!" Commander Wong shouted at him.
"This is too much even for you, Commander Du!" said another commander. "Enough!" The Celestial Emperor raised his voice. "I will not repeat myself for a third time!"
His voice instantly dropped the tension in the room, and all of the commanders retrieved their aura.

"I will now deliver my verdict," the Celestial Emperor declared. "Commander Du, your Second Squad will be demoted to the Thirteenth Squad and will restart their training from the beginning, as if they had just enlisted. As for you, Commander, you are hereby relieved of your position and duties until further notice."
"This subordinate acknowledges his punishment!" Commander Du responded with clenched fists. Even though he anticipated such punishment, it still pained him greatly.
'I swear I will get my revenge! Just you wait, bastard!'

The other commanders showed no outward reaction to the punishment, yet inwardly they rejoiced. Though they all served under the Celestial Emperor, rivalry ran deep among them, and one squad's demotion was another's promotion.
"You are all dismissed." The Celestial Emperor spoke as he stood from his throne.
The commanders bowed to him and remained in such a position until he completely left the room.
Once the Celestial Emperor was gone, the commanders started talking amongst themselves. As for Commander Du, he silently disappeared from the room with a determined expression on his face.
